label_scope: Recognizable component or motif in each image; approximate front boxes.

regions.note: The top shows the reverse/profile; the angled image shows part of the figure and crown.
The band-to-head shoulder is visible in both target views, with a different surface facing the camera.
The top shows the fluted edge and band. Some central face relief survives in the angled view.
The junction between the fluted shoulder and the hoop is recognizable in both views.
The top shows the head profile and band. The central raised figure is partly apparent in isometric.
The tab and band-to-head junction are recognizable from the top and at an angle.
The top shows the backing and rim. The angled image shows part of the raised figure.
The loop is clear from the front. The target views foreshorten or overlap it with the edge ornament.
